name: The Heavens
desc:
**The Heavens** are the other half of Lumen, which forms an inverted dome suspended above the Surface. Previously, a home to the Celestials, but currently only a part of the Lightborn reside there.

Civilization is dotted all around the Heavens in the Celestial Cities.

Waters of the Heavens are called the Nightsea. They are inky black, studded with twinkling points of light, known as Stars.
